method.few_observation_tiles: relevant tiles whose gap (> 1) has fewer than 10 observations at that gap (includes unobserved_gap_tiles)
method.kept_fraction_lower_bound: ESTIMATE: mean over relevant tiles of 1 / gap, an analytical floor on the fraction of a tile's ILP-input tile-frames the ILP keeps; it holds for tiles covered in at least two sampled frames of a video (a tile covered once is unconstrained and may be dropped); NULL for never-relevant tiles
method.kept_fraction_lower_bound_weighted: ESTIMATE: the same floor weighted by native-rate association counts (box-weighted proxy for relevant tile-frames)
method.keys: gap and sampling-rate keys are zero-padded ("01" ... "16"); tolerance keys are M = 1 - t
method.measured: MEASURED on the test split, per validated pruning setting: kept tile-frames in 022_pruned_polyominoes over ILP-input tile-frames (020_relevancy scores >= floor(T_r * 255), the rule the cached outputs follow; kept_outside counts kept tile-frames outside it), summed over test videos; kept_fraction pools settings, min/max range over them; bound_test_weighted is the 1 / (gap // s) floor weighted by the same test input; covered_share is input over all classified tile-frames
method.median_gap: lower median (quantile_disc), always a candidate gap
method.relevant_tile: at least one reference-track association at the native rate on the training videos
method.rule: gap = largest candidate gap with (correct + 1) / (total + 2) >= t, else 1; mistrack tolerance M = 1 - t (paper: largest gap with smoothed MissRate <= M). total is correct + incorrect associations counted at the frames gap gamma samples (about 1/gamma of the native-rate count), not the native-rate TotalA of §6.2
method.skipped_gap_tiles: tiles whose gap is above a smaller candidate gap that misses the tolerance
method.unobserved_gap_tiles: relevant tiles whose gap (> 1) has no observations at that gap (rate is the 0.5 prior)
method.validated_configs: Tetris rows of the test-split tradeoff table (evaluation/090_tradeoff/tradeoff.csv); rows include tile-padding and canvas-scale variants, which share one pruning setting (validated_pruning_settings counts distinct 022 settings)
method.with_sample_rate: p022 divides each gap by the whole-frame sampling rate s (floor, at least 1); effective gap s * max(gap // s, 1) frames; floor over sampled frames
